audit_scope: Read-only design review; continuation wrapper has not yet been inspected or executed by this auditor.
design_verdict: Feasible with private scheduling bindings and explicit execution-policy exception log.
frozen_method_unchanged: Original query-only runtime remains exactly150,50 per dataset.
Model, prompts, decoding, retrieval, merge, child/goal/final processing and native scorer remain unchanged.
No frozen source, original controller claim, dispatch, old request, successful receipt or unknown liability is overwritten.

parent_recovery.scope: Only a private eligible binding may force these two observed incomplete parent cases. Already-successful or algorithm-failed cases are ineligible.
parent_recovery.400_exception: One diagnostic request for the same failed HTTP400 payload is beyond the original infrastructure-only automatic retry allowlist. Declare it before dispatch; do not silently call it a preplanned retry.
parent_recovery.unknown_recovery: One infrastructure recovery in a fresh immutable namespace; retain the previous unknown reserve even after a new response.
parent_recovery.first_physical_payload_check: For each pending parent case, assert its first uncached create payload equals the complete old failed request payload before wire dispatch.
parent_recovery.prefix_reuse: Use the unchanged success-only source_catalog and full-payload cache; failed and unknown receipts are not success cache entries.

diagnostics.safe_injection: Wrap the privately bound run_case to pass a per-case proxy around its client.chat.completions.create. Record error class, provider status/code/message/body and payload identity, then re-raise the same exception.
diagnostics.do_not_do: Do not change frozen OneShot or StreamingClient or monkeypatch their shared module globals. Do not change the request arguments or add automatic client retries.
diagnostics.security: Do not log API keys, authorization headers or environment secrets.

candidate_scheduling.guard: Do not fake a missing parent as success or algorithm_failure merely to bypass the unchanged candidate-prefix guard.
candidate_scheduling.candidate_recovery: At most one r001 recovery for eligible infrastructure failures, without repeating success cases.
